name: Network Mapping & Topology Discovery
description: Ability to discover and map network topology, including subnets, routing paths, VLAN structures, and trust relationships. Covers traceroute analysis, ARP discovery, network diagramming, and the synthesis of scanning and enumeration data into coherent network maps.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to network mapping or topology discovery

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands basic network topology concepts and the purpose of network mapping during engagements
evidence: Can explain subnets, VLANs, and routing at a conceptual level
Understands why network maps are valuable in penetration testing
Knows basic tools such as traceroute and ARP discovery

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs basic network discovery and creates simple topology diagrams under supervision
evidence: Uses ARP scans and ping sweeps to discover live hosts
Runs traceroute to identify routing paths and hop counts
Creates basic network diagrams from discovery results
Documents discovered subnets and host relationships under review

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently maps complex network environments and identifies segmentation boundaries
evidence: Synthesizes data from multiple sources into comprehensive network maps
Identifies VLAN boundaries, trust relationships, and dual-homed hosts
Detects network segmentation gaps and potential pivot points
Produces professional network diagrams suitable for client reports

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Maps large and complex enterprise environments; automates topology discovery; mentors others
evidence: Automates network mapping workflows for large-scale engagements
Maps multi-site environments with complex routing and segmentation
Identifies non-obvious trust relationships and implicit access paths
Mentors junior staff on systematic network discovery methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines network mapping methodology; develops custom discovery tools; trains teams
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's network mapping standard methodology
Develops custom tools for automated topology discovery and visualization
Published research on network discovery or topology analysis techniques
Trains teams on network mapping strategy for complex environments

assessment_methods.description: Map a multi-subnet lab environment and produce an accurate topology diagram identifying all segmentation boundaries
Review network maps from recent engagements for accuracy and completeness
